Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui. Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes. Por que juntar-se à BAT? Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores. A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. Encaramos as interrupções de carreira como oportunidades e não como obstáculos. title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
description: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform Staff Software Engineer – Digital Experience Platform (DXP) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. You’ll be responsible for Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines. Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms. Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review. Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability. Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank. We are looking for a person who has Must Have Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands‑on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI‑powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them. Strong software architecture skills , with experience designing multi‑component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows. Deep understanding of design‑to‑code pipelines, design systems or component‑driven UI development , ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation. Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products : prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development. Excellent communication skills , translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership. Product‑minded mindset , balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities. Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns : BDC (Backend‑Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems. Will be a Plus Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation. Hands‑on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows. Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms , agent farms or multi‑agent systems. Understanding of analytical architectures , experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences. Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs. Contributions to open‑source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI‑for‑developers community. title: Arrivals & Departures Manager
description: Arrivals & Departures Manager Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Arrivals & Departures Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering all Arrivals & Departures operations for and during the tournament. This role ensures seamless, safe, and efficient transportation services for all FIFA client groups and spectators, guaranteeing operational readiness and flawless delivery on all airports used for the tournament. The position also liaises closely with the Airport Operators, Federal Government and Host City authorities. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager and oversees key arrivals and departures sub‑projects, including international and inter‑city planning and operations, as well as aviation venue management. The Arrivals & Departures Manager collaborates closely with Airport Operators, Federal Government agencies, Host City authorities, the LFS Senior Transport Manager, the Transport Government Liaison & Integration Manager, and FIFA to define and implement an integrated concept of operations for Arrivals & Departures services. It is also the responsibility of this position to develop airport operational plans that provide essential support to both the Transport Functional Area and Event Services. The successful candidate is expected to be a proactive and resilient professional, capable of leading and managing a team while operating efficiently under pressure and delivering to strict timelines. Managing the area’s activities and resources within the approved budget is also a key component of the role. The Arrivals & Departures Manager must ensure strong integration with all other FWWC2027 functional areas present at the airport—including Workforce, Volunteers, Guest Operations & Protocol Etiquette, Team Services, and IT—to ensure alignment with established FIFA SLAs and the seamless delivery of airport operations. Key Responsibilities Designing and implementing a suitable A&D service model that covers all tournament airports, to service all FIFA constituent groups (Teams, Referees, FIFA officials, VIPs, Workforce, Dignitaries, Media, Broadcast, Commercial affiliates) at all official point‑of‑entry/exit sites, based on FIFA requirements and agreed service levels. Planning and implementing an Arrivals & Departures Plan for each FIFA constituent group based on FIFA requirements and service levels. Negotiating with the airport authorities and government agencies to ensure that all the structures and procedures of the airports are aligned to deliver the best operation on peak throughout the FWWC2027 operational period. Designing the concept of operations, the venue operating plan, and all relevant A&D policies and procedures. Integrating with other LFS Transport workstreams functions within Event Transport for airport pick‑ups and drop‑offs. Coordinating with meet‑and‑greet companies regarding VIP arrivals and departures services. Contributing to the slot allocation plan of the host‑city airports for the tournament period, ensuring priority for FWWC2027‑related aircraft movements (mainly PMA charter flights and FIFA VIP private jets). Ensuring successful integration of the FWWC2027 air traffic into the overall international airline schedule. Participating proactively in the Airport/Mobility Working Groups and ensuring, via close collaboration with HC transport, civil aviation and airport operators and authorities, that the air traffic matches airport and terminal capacities. Planning and developing the tournament time operational plan for the airport (airside and landside operations) in coordination with airport authorities and other FWWC2027 functional areas (Security, Logistics, Team Services, Guest Operations, Marketing, etc.). Ensuring integration of the airport operational plan with the airport transportation plan and its correlation with all other transport services and operations. Delivering the final operational plan and ensuring successful and smooth operations for all constituent groups. Implementing project management within A&D and airport management, identifying key milestones of international and inter‑city arrivals and departures / aviation and airport management sub‑projects. Identifying and addressing key risks of the international and inter‑city arrivals and departures / aviation and airport management sub‑projects. Preparing content (slides, handouts, etc.) and reports for the FWWC2027 related management meetings and working group meetings. Supporting recruiting and hiring of each host‑city A&D manager, assigning responsibilities, and managing the team from planning through delivery. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees across all airports. Ensuring all airport staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of operational workshops, briefings and role‑specific instructions. This HQ manager maintains consistent training standards across all host‑city airports. Providing regular reporting to the transport senior manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Supporting test events, rehearsals, and operational readiness exercises. Overseeing the installation and readiness of signage, transport desk, wayfinding, etc. Maintaining constant live communication with transport command and control, providing real‑time updates on airport operations, incidents, delays, and emerging issues. Ensuring that all critical issues are escalated promptly, enabling rapid decision‑making and coordinated responses across all transport functions, government agencies and airport operators. This includes monitoring on‑ground conditions, reporting deviations from the plan, and implementing solutions to ensure smooth and uninterrupted service delivery. Your Profile Qualifications Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport, Logistics, Civil Engineering, Project Management, Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to the position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Experience Minimum of ten (10) years of event arrivals and departures (airport operations) experience in international major events in at least three (3) world‑class sport/football events (e.g., FIFA World Cup, Olympic Games). Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time‑critical project. Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale. Proven experience of managing airport operations projects of a similar size and scale. Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships. Skills Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles. Advanced knowledge of team leadership, business process management. Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships. Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment. Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities. Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests. Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project‑focused organisation. Proven project management skills within a complex project. Language skills – English language fluency both written and spoken. Strong analytical and organisational skills. Proven solution‑orientated decision‑making skills. Ability to work under pressure to immutable deadlines. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual – Portuguese and English. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

No BTG valorizamos espírito empreendedor, autonomia, agilidade, foco no cliente, excelência e visão de longo prazo. Agimos com integridade, responsabilidade, simplicidade, inconformismo e dedicação. Meritocracia está no centro do nosso dia a dia. Temos um escritório open space e uma estrutura horizontal onde você vai conversar com os melhores profissionais de mercado e ter desafios reais e diários. Sobre a área: Você fará parte do time de ArtificialIntelligence & Data Science, junto à equipe de DataAnalytics do banco, atuando como referência técnica em engenharia de IA. Estamos construindo a próxima geração de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa e Machine Learning no BTG Pactual, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes inteligentes, produtos baseados em LLMs e modelos clássicos de ML voltados para geração de eficiência operacional e redução de custos no front office e backoffice do banco. No seu dia a dia: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico entre stakeholders de negócio e o time de engenharia, traduzindo necessidades em casos de uso viáveis com IA; Liderar o ciclo completo de produtos de IA Generativa e ML, da concepção e design de solução à entrega e sustentação em produção; Projetar e implementar pipelines de IA, integrando modelos internos e de mercado em sistemas e plataformas do banco; Ter autonomia para escolher metodologias e tecnologias adequadas, justificando seus trade-offs; Definir e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia de IA, avaliação de modelos e design de prompts dentro do time; Participar ativamente de fóruns técnicos e mentorar desenvolvedores júnior e pleno, conduzindo revisões técnicas e promovendo a evolução do time; Garantir a observabilidade, qualidade e rastreabilidade das soluções de IA em produção; Manter documentação técnica e de processos atualizada, servindo como base de conhecimento para o time. Esperamos de Você: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharias, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas, com ao menos 2-3 anos de formado; Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma híbrida (3x por semana) no escritório em Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro; Mínimo de 3-4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados, com ao menos 2 anos focados em soluções de IA Generativa e LLMs em ambiente produtivo; Experiência prática em machine learning clássico e ciência de dados, com domínio de bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, ferramentas de experimentação, estatística e análise exploratória; Bom conhecimento de técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural; Domínio de SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (DynamoDB); Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure), especialmente serviços serverless (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS); Sólida base em engenharia de software, com experiência em infraestrutura, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, boas práticas de programação; Experiência com Python como linguagem principal de desenvolvimento; Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não-técnicos, adaptando o nível de abstração conforme o interlocutor. Diferenciais: Experiência com modelos de Deep Learning e fine-tuning (TensorFlow ou PyTorch); Experiência combinando modelos determinísticos, ML clássico e LLMs em pipelines híbridos; Vivência em práticas de segurança aplicadas a sistemas de IA (controle de acesso, sanitização de inputs, proteção contra prompt injection, etc); Experiência com testes e estratégias de avaliação de modelos e pipelines de IA (evals, benchmarks, testes de regressão); Experiência com FastAPI e pipelines de CI/CD via Azure DevOps; Conhecimento de ferramentas de big data (Spark, Airflow); Experiência prática em inferência estatística e planejamento de experimentos; Conhecimentos sobre o funcionamento de fundos de investimento, incluindo sua estrutura, regulação e operação, aplicado a desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas para o segmento; Inglês avançado; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição; Planos por adesão como Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida; Desconto em Farmácia; Programa de Nutrição; Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã. O BTG Pactual respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Coordenador de Atendimento
description: Descrição da vaga A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas. Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Success in this role means ensuring high‑quality compliance while proactively driving automation and scalability across the region. remediation actions Use audit outcomes to identify process improvements and control enhancements Process transformation and efficiency Drive continuous improvement of indirect tax processes with a AI‑enabled tools to improve accuracy, consistency, and cycle time across compliance and audit support activities Work with Finance, IT, and transformation teams to embed indirect tax requirements into upstream systems and processes rather than relying on manual workarounds Support the implementation and ongoing optimization of ERP and tax technology solutions, including Oracle Cloud and indirect tax engines such as Vertex Monitor legislative and regulatory changes and assess whether process or system updates are required Stakeholder collaboration and execution model Partner closely with Finance (including Controllership), Accounting, Legal, IT, Operations, transformation teams, and external advisors Serve as a trusted point of contact for indirect tax matters, communicating clearly in Spanish and English Execute in‑house compliance workflows consistently with agreed processes and standards Qualifications Seven or more years of indirect tax experience, with a focus on Spanish‑speaking LATAM countries Hands‑on experience with in‑house indirect tax compliance preparation, audits, and advisory matters Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to provide clear, practical guidance in complex situations Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts in a business setting in Spanish and English Comfortable leveraging automation and AI‑enabled tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in tax processes, including data reconciliation and research Comfortable working with technology, including ERP systems (Oracle Cloud preferred) and tax engines or automation tools (Vertex experience is a plus) Big 4 and/or multinational corporate tax experience preferred Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and self‑motivated, with strong time and project management skills Ability to work effectively across functions in a fast‑paced, global organization Bachelor’s degree in title: Productivity Finance Specialist
description: Would you like to help improve project margin performance and recover value across the project lifecycle? Would you like to move beyond periodic reporting and play a direct role in business performance? Be part of a team that keeps moving! This role sits within the Global FPS (Flexible Pipe Systems) Productivity team and focuses on sustainably improving project margins, recovering lost value and supporting better business decisions. It is a hands‑on finance role for someone who wants to combine strong financial discipline with operational understanding, working closely with project, commercial, and functional teams to turn insight into action. Partner with the best As the Productivity Finance Specialist , you will partner closely with productivity, finance, project, and operational stakeholders to strengthen project margin reviews, identify recurring sources of margin leakage, and support recovery actions. You will connect productivity initiatives to project financial performance, improve confidence in reported benefits and help create a clearer, more trusted view of project financials. Responsibilities Partnering with the Productivity team, project teams, and finance colleagues to support project margin reviews (PMR) and margin improvement actions. Analysing project financial performance to identify margin leakage, recovery opportunities, recurring loss patterns, and improvement themes across the project lifecycle. Linking productivity initiatives to project financial outcomes, helping the business understand where actions are driving measurable improvement, where value is at risk, and where expected benefits are not yet visible in the numbers. Strengthening productivity governance by aligning baselines, assumptions, reporting logic, benefit tracking, and reconciliation to project financials, helping create one clear and trusted view of performance. Working with commercial, sourcing, engineering, manufacturing, and project stakeholders to understand root causes and translate findings into practical actions. Owning and developing the FPS product costing tool, ensuring it provides reliable costing insight for decision-making, while leading requirements, testing, adoption, and transition planning for more modern costing solutions. Supporting ad hoc analysis for senior leaders on margin performance, risk areas, recovery actions, and emerging trends. Using data, dashboards, and digital tools where useful to improve the speed, visibility, and consistency of financial insight. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role, you will: Have a strong finance foundation, with relevant experience in FP&A, project finance, commercial finance, operations finance, or business partnering. Be comfortable moving beyond reporting into a more operational, problem‑solving role with direct business impact. Have strong analytical capability and the ability to translate financial performance into clear business actions. Be confident challenging data inconsistencies, aligning stakeholders around common definitions, and improving trust in the numbers. Be able to challenge constructively, influence non-finance stakeholders, and work effectively across functions. Have strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with project, operational, commercial, and finance leaders. Be comfortable working in an environment where processes, tools, and visibility are still developing, while helping bring more structure and consistency over time. Be confident using Excel and financial systems; exposure to Power BI or data visualisation would be useful. Desired characteristics Have experience in project-based, manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or operational environments Have experience supporting project financial reviews, or structured margin analysis. Have exposure to productivity, cost-out, value improvement, or recovery programmes. Have experience reconciling multiple financial views or helping establish common reporting standards across teams. Have experience working with performance dashboards or visual reporting tools. Be a qualified or part-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or bring comparable finance experience with strong commercial credibility. Have interest in using data and digital tools to improve decision making and business visibility. Have a curious, pragmatic, and resilient approach, with a strong sense of ownership and a focus on measurable outcomes. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following working patterns: Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 4:00pm - On‑site RETIC (Fundão/RJ) Working for you Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing programs. Comprehensive private medical care options. Life insurance and disability coverage. Tailored financial programs. Additional elected or voluntary benefits. title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
description: Staff Software Engineer – Digital Experience Platform (DXP) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at: About the Role The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. Today, building “Magic App”-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps — DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences. We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle). As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers. You’ll be responsible for Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines. Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms. Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review. Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability. Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank. We are looking for a person who has Must Have Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands‑on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI-powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them. Strong software architecture skills, with experience designing multi-component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows. Deep understanding of design-to-code pipelines, design systems or component-driven UI development, ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation. Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products: prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development. Proven ability to lead cross‑functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments. Excellent communication skills, translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership. Product‑minded mindset, balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities. Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns: BDC (Backend-Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems. Will be a Plus Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation. Hands‑on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows. Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms, agent farms or multi‑agent systems. Understanding of analytical architectures, experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences. Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs. Contributions to open‑source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI-for-developers community. Location for this opportunity Miami, Florida, United States Toronto, Canada São Paulo, Brazil Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Campinas, Brazil Belo Horizonte, Brazil Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit Our Benefits – Global Roles For global, multi-location roles like this, our benefits package is competitive in each country and generally includes: Competitive compensation and the opportunity of earning equity at Nu Health / Medical Insurance Life Insurance (and AD&D where applicable) Extended maternity and paternity leaves Nucleo – our learning platform of courses NuLanguage – our language learning program NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program Paid time off and local holidays Retirement / savings plans (e.g., 401(k), HSA/FSA in the US; country-specific plans elsewhere) Work‑from‑home allowance Relocation assistance package, if applicable Details for each location will be shared during the process, aligned with local regulations and practices. description: The Company You’ll Join Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the "Last Mile" problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't "talk" to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). You will be responsible for solving the "Last Mile" delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client's unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go-to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines. The team's core mission is to solve the "Last Mile" problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client's unique technical environment. This involves: Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions. Analyze client downstream system requirements to draft comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification files. Navigating complex data mapping requirements. Managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures. Leading a technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in the client‑required format and under tight deadlines. Facilitate daily stand‑ups to track progress, remove blockers, and ensure alignment with the delivery roadmap. Perform Internal QA on custom templates (Excel, CSV, JSON) to ensure 100% accuracy against the signed‑off specifications. Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs. The Team You’ll Work With You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers. About You We are looking for a collaborative and detail‑oriented lead who enjoys the challenge of turning complex data into seamless client solutions. Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files. Integration Architect. You are adept at navigating complex data mapping requirements and are familiar with secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, including APIs, SFTP, SharePoint, and Cloud Storage. Agile Delivery Lead. You are comfortable leading a specialized technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in client‑required formats while maintaining alignment with strict delivery roadmaps and deadlines. Operational Driver. You are familiar with tools like Jira and Confluence, using them to govern the full development lifecycle, prioritize backlogs, document technical specs, and facilitate daily stand‑ups to remove blockers. Quality : You take a hands‑on approach to Internal QA, ensuring 100% accuracy against signed‑off specifications before any data is delivered to a stakeholder. First‑Line Responder. You act as the first line of defense for production issues, performing the initial triage and root‑cause investigation of reported bugs before prioritizing engineering tickets. 3+ years of experience recommended in technical implementation, integration engineering, or technical project management. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer ID67841
description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. You will contribute to architecture decisions, design reusable client integration systems following secure cloud best practices, and participate in code reviews and CI/CD processes as a trusted technical resource for the team. The role offers significant ownership from day one in a product built from the ground up. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build a cleanly designed, reusable client integration system adhering to secure cloud software best practices from start to finish; Collaborate with design and product teams to understand requirements, create estimates, plan sprints, and meet delivery timelines; Plan and accurately estimate construction and delivery timelines; Contribute to technical documentation and automated build and deployment processes designed to increase engineer efficiency; Review code submitted by other software engineers and submit your own code for review as part of the pull‑request deployment process. MUST HAVES 4+ years’ experience of SaaS experience ; High level of proficiency in Java , React , and SQL ; Knowledge of or prior experience with microservices architecture ; Front end experience with JavaScript , Typescript , and ReactJS ; DevOps mindset of automation and continuous improvement; Good understanding of observability and familiarity with strong CI/CD practices; A proven ability to meet deadlines, motivate others, and consistently produce high quality, impactful results; Upper-intermediate and higher English proficiency. NICE TO HAVES Experience building software in the cloud with AWS preferred. PERKS AND BENEFITS Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr Reservoir Engineer
description: Context & Environment Trabalho em uma equipe multicultural de geociências e reservatórios. Ambiente de multifuncionalidade, proatividade e solidariedade entre todas as equipes de Geociências Operadas, OBO e Transversais. Expectativas de excelência técnica e comportamental, com alto grau de autonomia técnica. Principais Atividades O(a) funcionário(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos princípios do One Maestro, com o objetivo de proteger as pessoas, o meio ambiente, os ativos e a reputação da empresa. Deverá promover a cultura de segurança em todas as atividades de geociências e garantir uma articulação eficaz com o HSE da afiliada e a coordenação de HSE de geociências da matriz (cf. CR EP GSR 002). Estudos de Reservatórios, incluindo construção, atualização, ajuste histórico (history-matching) e previsões (forecasting) Construir, atualizar e manter modelos dinâmicos de simulação de reservatórios e outras ferramentas de previsão para os ativos designados, garantindo consistência técnica e rastreabilidade das premissas. Definir e aplicar abordagens adequadas de modelagem (dentro das estruturas estabelecidas da afiliada), incluindo estratégia de history-matching, lógica de previsão, casos de sensibilidade e envelopes de incerteza. Integrar o entendimento mais recente do subsolo dos ativos aos modelos dinâmicos, assegurando consistência com a interpretação estática e os dados de superfície. Conduzir estudos complexos de history-matching e previsão, analisar resultados e traduzi-los em insights técnicos claros e recomendações focadas nos ativos. Realizar estudos avançados de reservatórios conforme necessário: integração dinâmica de dados, interpretação e síntese, análise de incertezas, modelagem integrada de redes, análise de mecanismos de produção e suporte à vigilância. Identificar lacunas de dados e falhas de integração que impactem a confiabilidade dos modelos e a robustez das previsões, formulando recomendações à equipe do ativo para estudos adicionais ou aquisição de dados. Garantir a padronização da gestão, armazenamento e indexação dos dados utilizados, modelos desenvolvidos e ferramentas. Integração com a Equipe do Ativo Atuar como principal colaborador(a) sênior de engenharia de reservatórios para os ativos designados, apoiando os Líderes de GSR e stakeholders multidisciplinares com análises e recomendações robustas. Fornecer ferramentas de previsão de reservatórios e insights técnicos consolidados para apoiar previsões de produção, avaliação de reservas e decisões de gestão de reservatórios no nível do ativo. Acompanhar e integrar novos dados de subsolo que impactem o entendimento do reservatório, assegurando atualização tempestiva de modelos e estudos. Apoiar discussões técnicas e avaliação de opções relacionadas a poços, estratégia de depleção e sequenciamento de desenvolvimento, articulando claramente incertezas e sensibilidades. Oferecer mentoria informal e suporte técnico a engenheiros de reservatórios menos experientes. Interações Internas e Externas à Afiliada Para ativos operados Obtenção de dados dinâmicos junto às entidades operacionais e contratadas responsáveis por atividades acordadas de aquisição e interpretação de dados de subsolo, bem como atividades de desenvolvimento de ativos (perfuração/completação, produção, flow assurance, etc.). Prer requisito: contribuição para a comunicação alinhada da TEP-Brasil com parceiros sobre temas de desenvolvimento de subsolo, produção e entrega de reservas. Liderar discussões técnicas de subsolo relacionadas à sua especialidade durante essas interações. Para ativos Não Operados Prer requisito: apresentar resultados de estudos técnicos que influenciem positivamente o desempenho do operador em desenvolvimento, produção e recuperação final. Liderar discussões de subsolo relacionadas à sua especialidade durante essas reuniões. Promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento entre ativos e no nível corporativo, por meio do voluntariado em lições aprendidas e melhores práticas, em benefício de outros ativos da TEP-Brasil e entidades da matriz. Responsabilidades Entregar estudos de engenharia de reservatórios e ferramentas de previsão de alta qualidade, apoiando previsões de produção, avaliação de reservas e atividades de gestão de reservatórios. Garantir robustez e clareza nas recomendações de engenharia de reservatórios, incluindo comunicação transparente de incertezas, premissas e sensibilidades. Contribuir para a tomada de decisão dos ativos dentro do framework de governança e validação da afiliada. Formação Graduação em Engenharia de Petróleo, Química ou equivalente, com especialização em Engenharia de Reservatórios ou outra área relacionada ao subsolo. Experiência Mais de 8 anos de experiência profissional em engenharia de reservatórios. Forte cultura de subsolo, com conhecimento operacional (preparação de poços, perfuração/completação e monitoramento), prática avançada de modelagem geológica e de reservatórios, gestão de incertezas, desenvolvimento de reservatórios, previsão de produção, avaliação de reservas e colaboração interdisciplinar. Habilidades interpessoais reconhecidas, com forte capacidade e interesse em comunicação técnica. Histórico comprovado de colaboração ativa no escopo de 2G&R e com outras disciplinas de desenvolvimento e negócios. Competências Técnicas Proficiência avançada e conhecimento de softwares de reservatórios utilizados para interpretação e modelagem. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Venue Technology Manager (Porto Alegre)
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil. Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s). title: Profissional DBA Oracle GoldenGate (OGG) Sênior
description: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. O profissional será responsável por apoiar tecnicamente a evolução de arquiteturas de dados orientadas a Data Lake, Spark e Object Storage, utilizando preferencialmente Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture na OCI. Sincronismo entre Initial Load e CDC Restartabilidade Tuning de replicação Lag de replicação Integração com ambientes cloud e Data Lake Apoiar migrações e integrações entre ambientes Oracle on-premise e OCI. Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Dados, Arquitetura, Infraestrutura e Engenharia. Para essa vaga, você deve ter: Experiência prática em arquiteturas similares a: Oracle Database → Data Pump Export com FLASHBACK_SCN → Transferência para OCI Object Storage → Import temporário em ambiente staging → Extract temporário OGG → Replicat Initial Load → OCI Object Storage / Data Lake Conhecimentos Obrigatórios: Experiência sólida com Oracle GoldenGate Classic e Microservices Architecture. Forte vivência em replicação Oracle de alta volumetria. Conhecimento avançado em: Extract, Replicat, Trails, AFTERCSN, Integrated Extract, Parallel Replicat, checkpointing, troubleshooting de lag/performance Experiência prática com: Oracle OCI, Object Storage, Autonomous Database, Data Pump, CDC, Data Lake, Spark, Conhecimento avançado de Oracle Database, internals, redo/archive, SCN, undo/flashback, paralelismo, tuning, Perfil analítico, executor e orientado à resolução de problemas complexos. É um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência com Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapter. Vivência com arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento em OCI Data Flow/Spark. Experiência com ambientes distribuídos, Kubernetes e observabilidade. Atuação prévia em ambientes críticos e de missão crítica com grande volume de dados. Professional presence and demeanor that commands credibility and respect across the institution. title: Gerente Sr de Manutenção
description: We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager. The Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager is the site lead for all Engineering matters within a building. They are responsible for leading their team and building a culture of safety; for ensuring all statutory compliance requirements are followed to provide a safe working environment for all occupants of the building; for providing a high level of equipment availability to the General Manager or Site Leader and for working with the Global Engineering team to plan for future growth. They are also required to take part in network wide improvement initiatives and to implement standards created elsewhere in the network. Key Job Responsibilities Lead the team, own the annual reporting responsibilities for the team and mentor their direct reports who in turn develop the technicians within the team. Work with the site Safety, Environmental, Sustainability departments & Site Leadership to implement, record and audit Amazon and statutory compliance programs to provide a safe working environment for all staff. Own the legal responsibilities as the site engineering lead within this framework. Work with the recruitment team to ensure allocated headcount is filled with high quality experienced staff. This may include support to Apprentice and Graduate programs. Implement standards validated by the Global Engineering team for the region and participate in continuous improvement initiatives to create or update standards as required in order to provide high levels of safety and equipment availability to our internal customers. A key focus is on preventative maintenance programs. Maintain equipment failure contingency plans, coordinate rehearsals with affected teams and be prepared to work in a flexible manner to ensure failures or breakdowns are rectified as quickly as possible. Maintain a long-term focus by working with Site Management, Finance, the Global Engineering team and internal design teams to plan for future growth, upgrades or new equipment roll outs. About the Team Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep. Across Brazil we have several Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers and Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operations is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business to run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world. Qualifications Bachelor's degree Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead, or experience managing teams Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems Experience with project management Knowledge of PLC based controls systems Knowledge of Computerized Maintenance Management System programs Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process Full working knowledge of all specialized engineering and facilities equipment within the Amazon Customer Fulfillment (CF) as well as maintenance and safety procedures. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. title: Party Chief
description: UTEC, Acteon's Geo-services business line, harnesses data to optimise designs, save time and maximise your project's economic value by providing a holistic understanding of the marine environment. Our insights underpin customers' decision-making from design to asset life extension, ensuring every decision delivers. Party Chief is UTEC's senior onboard representative and must ensure that all work is conducted in the best interests of UTEC and the Client. They are responsible for the safe, efficient and timely conduct of the project and for the assurance of quality. On site, they shall liaise closely with the Client Representative and Ship's Master and shall manage the day-to-day work program, subject only to direct instruction from or through the Project Manager and, in matters of vessel safety and discipline, the Ship's Master. It is the Party Chief's role to supervise those members of the survey team for whom they are responsible from the standpoint of technical and personal management. The Party Chief shall work closely with the vessel's Master in the event of an emergency or condition requiring shore assistance. The Party Chief shall oversee each use of the current UTEC field reference manuals and standard forms ensuring that, upon demobilisation, a copy of any proposed revisions/corrections is saved to file and hard copy returned to the UTEC office within the project file. The role is based offshore and will require travel to support UTEC operations; periods of onshore support may also be required working either remotely or from UTEC offices/workshops. The successful candidates will be based in Brazil. Duties On appointment to the field project, the Party Chief shall manage mobilisation in accordance with the Mobilisation Procedure (SOP-001) Immediately prior to first sailing, the Party Chief shall email the Project Manager all check lists duly signed and completed to date Ensure that all survey parameters have been checked before the commencement of fieldwork Ensure that all survey systems are in place for the contract and that all pre-sailing checks are carried out and documented Ensure the Survey Event Log Book is comprehensively maintained by the Surveyors Maintain a Rental Equipment list and return to office with Project Site file both hard & electronic Initiate and close out NCR (non-conformance reports) Submit requests for consumables/spares and ensure that the onboard Spares Master Register (on Excel) is maintained up to date The Party Chief shall email signed checklists upon demobilisation Document any contractual variations and concessions The Party Chief shall ensure that all data recorded is properly labelled, stored and logged and can be accounted for at all times especially when being prepared for transit. Depending on the nature of the project, much of this work will be performed by others, including the QC Geophysicist, but the Party Chief must ensure there are no 'gaps' in the system as (s)he bears overall responsibility. On completion of mobilisation alongside and of all harbour checks and calibrations, the Party Chief shall compile his/her checklist with those of the Senior Surveyor, the QC Geophysicist and the Engineer-in-Charge and after signature, shall send all checklists to the UTEC Operations Manager. Similarly, after signature upon completion of demobilisation, these documents shall be sent to the UTEC Operations Manager The Party Chief shall always be alert to the impact the deployment of survey sensors might have upon the vessel's ability to manoeuvre. Similarly, they shall be aware of the vessel's working location with particular regard to the proximity of structures and other vessels Complete Final Survey Report as per UTEC approved format Undertake field personnel assessments fairly, reflecting individual strengths and weaknesses and recommending training as appropriate and submit to the Operations Manager ashore upon the departure of any crew member or upon the occasion of his/her being relieved Fully brief all members of survey crew and key members of the ship's crew. Party Chief shall ensure that a Briefing Meeting is conducted, and a list maintained and signed by all attendees and retained in the project file (FRF-013) Preparation and presentation of safety meetings at project start-up and ongoing toolbox meetings with marine and survey watch operators before deploying equipment or other potentially hazardous operations. Special emphasis is to be given to assist the Master and Safety Officer in promoting safe working practices Required Bilingual in Portuguese and English, strongly preferred Education in Geomatics, Surveying Science Relevant industry experience or military/academic experience in survey related discipline, including relevant management experience Satisfactory completion of competence criteria for Senior Surveyor, Senior Survey Engineer, Senior Geophysicist or Senior Data Processor Nominally 48 months' experience, including 400 operational days offshore as Senior Surveyor, Senior Survey Engineer, Senior Geophysicist or Senior Data Processor #J-18808-Ljbffr
